listings.title: Hopewell Estate Sale: John Deere, Tools, Dept 56 & MORE!
listings.description: White Pine Estate Sales & Auctions will be in Hopewell, NJ, offering an outstanding selection of tools, clothing, vintage decor, and holiday collectibles. Featured equipment includes a Cub Cadet GT 2550 lawn tractor, a John Deere 317 riding lawn mower, a John Deere 15 utility cart, a gas-powered woodchipper shredder, and a Mantis gas tiller. Workshop enthusiasts will find a vintage floor-standing drill press, stationary table saw, belt and disc sander, air compressor, red tool chest, Werner aluminum extension ladder, and various hand tools and hardware accessories. Tons of vintage collectibles and home accents, depression glass, cast iron school desks, Hummels, tin party noisemakers, TONS of boxed Department 56, Snowbabies, Boyd's teddy bears, dolls, Christmas & holiday pieces and vintage wooden Christmas cutouts. Porcelain china dinnerware, great wood & upholstered furniture, lots of garage items, headboards, bedroom furniture, tables, couches, nightstands, chests, glass front display cabinets, yard tools, tons of glassware, knick knacks, Lenox, framed oil paintings and so much more! More pictures will be added! Keep checking back.
